channel.title: DebtLab: debt payoff calculators and tables

item.title: How to Pay Off $25,000 Credit Card Debt at 20% APR
item.description: $25,000 at 20% APR with only minimum payments could take 32 yrs 3 mo and cost $40,650 in interest. Paying $930 a month clears it in 3 years. See the full payoff table, balance transfer and loan math. Educational, not financial advice.

item.title: Free Printable Debt Tracker: List Every Debt
